gp: archived kernel parameters held fixed; posterior mean and correlated covariance recomputed with each window exterior
normalization: integrate exact bin edges; normalize once on full archived histogram support; never renormalize fitted subset
inference: 90% bounded asymptotic CLs with observed and background-Asimov profiles; fixed-mass fixed-shape local p0 only
shape_selection: each shape prespecified; no best-shape p-value reported
missing_guard_rule: exclude mass if either exterior side has fewer than 3 bins; do not change primary mass coverage
injection_strength: one Gaussian-primary observed 90% upper-limit amplitude at each anchor
conditional_scope: Observed data and frozen GP states. No new coverage, global significance, hyperparameter optimization, or detector response calibration.
